classificationCorrections: Explicit scripts/fixtures proof data and fixture paths precede generated-directory detection, including scripts/fixtures/build/cases.json.
A directory named build does not imply generated output; handwritten tracked build owners remain eligible for their semantic category.
No apps/web/prototypes files are tracked in either inspected snapshot; no blanket prototype production inclusion or exclusion is introduced.

method.snapshots: git rev-parse HEAD; git ls-tree -r --name-only -z; git show COMMIT:PATH
method.lines: Nonblank physical lines: split CRLF/LF/CR, retain lines with nonempty ECMAScript trim()
method.bytes: Exact UTF-8 Git blob bytes, including blank lines and final newline
method.documentationBoundary: Every tracked .md/.mdx/.rst file plus apps/docs .astro content. Documentation-site handwritten TS/TSX examples remain separate unrelated source; CSS/assets/license TXT are excluded. Root instruction files count as documentation.
method.externalConfigurationBoundary: Tracked package manifests, tsconfig JSON, Vite/Vitest/Astro config and root Biome/Knip/workspace config; separate from executable build/gate owners
method.proofBoundary: All scripts/fixtures files, script tests/specs, mounted browser runners, and run-browser-build-fixture.mjs; includes JSON fixture manifests and fixture tsconfigs
limitations: Committed HEAD only; uncommitted integration edits are not counted.
same-metrics does not assert byte equality or semantic equality.
No minification, performance or capability-retention inference from metrics.

semanticCategoryBoundaries.applicationProduction: Handwritten TS/TSX/JS/MJS/CJS within apps/server/src, apps/web/src and packages/contracts/src; excludes tests/specs, fixtures, declarations, generated output and dependencies.
semanticCategoryBoundaries.relocatedApplicationProduction: Every other tracked handwritten JS/TS owner of application responsibilities outside original roots, except explicitly unrelated UI/docs source and separately declared build/gate/proof owners. Include replacement packages and relocated owners.
semanticCategoryBoundaries.sourceTestsAndFixtures: All tracked source-root test/spec and explicit fixtures, including non-code fixture data.
semanticCategoryBoundaries.externalBuildGateOwners: Executable non-test JS/TS in scripts and config/dependency-cruiser; explicit proof runners belong to proof instead.
semanticCategoryBoundaries.externalProofTestsAndFixtures: Every scripts/fixtures file, script test/spec, client-owner/resource-results/workflows browser runner and run-browser-build-fixture.mjs. Includes fixtures/build/cases.json and fixture tsconfigs.
semanticCategoryBoundaries.externalBuildConfiguration: Tracked package manifests, tsconfig JSON, Vite/Vitest/Astro config and root Biome/Knip/workspace config; fixture configuration remains proof.
semanticCategoryBoundaries.trackedDocumentation: All tracked .md/.mdx/.rst plus apps/docs .astro content, including root instructions and UI style READMEs. Excludes CSS/assets/license TXT. Docs TS/TSX examples remain unrelated source.
semanticCategoryBoundaries.unrelatedSourceTestsAndFixtures: All tests/fixtures outside original source roots and external proof, including independent UI tests.
semanticCategoryBoundaries.unrelatedHandwrittenSource: Independent UI handwritten source and standalone docs TS/TSX examples, separate from application production.

finalSnapshot.status: Measured committed source and documentation; later publication commit adds only this generated evidence asset.

provenance.measurement: Actual git ls-tree and git show committed UTF-8 blobs; original aggregate and all 85 original per-file rows verified.
provenance.generatedAsset: Complete generated comparison evidence, not handwritten production. Includes no source chunks, credentials or configuration contents.

historicalDocumentationReconciliation.scope: Historical README/CONTEXT/architecture subset is not all repository documentation; obsolete historical figures are withdrawn in architecture.

Optional action/authorization payload bags and unscoped cross-kind public IDs; broad host executable/path/configuration inputs.
State-bearing HTTP read authority, generic acknowledgements and submitted-path canonical identity guesses.
Broad no-argument hook, reader-owned observation, fabricated defaults, mutable publication and whole-content provider subscriptions.
Repeated resource/Automation joins, obsolete Overview/settings presentation helpers and writable selection mirrors.
Eleven local executors, eight repeated settings gates, view-owned version capture, aggregate busy/error overwrite and duplicate authorization feedback policy.
Parallel handwritten Classification/Session stdout interfaces and AJV generic certification; exported unused schema intermediates.
Incidental schema-copy, method-order, minimum publication, ticket-winner/global event order and cross-channel delivery-order assertions.

Explicit scoped source evidence and retention, coherent activation, terminal lifecycle/drains, relational/schema-derived contracts, finite host authority, state-free correlated outcomes and immutable current-policy/scoped uncertainty owners justify added responsibility. All relocated owners remain counted. No net reduction, minification/formatting savings, generated replacement, omitted capability or performance gain is claimed.
